name: WaitForTextOnCmdSession
label: Wait for Text on CMD Session
discription: Waits for a specific text on a previously opened CMD session.

fields.name: CmdSession
fields.label: CMD Session
fields.description: The process representing the open CMD session.

fields.name: TextToWaitFor
fields.label: Text to Wait For
fields.description: The text or regular expression to wait for in the CMD session output.

fields.name: TimeoutMs
fields.label: Timeout (ms)
fields.description: Maximum time to wait in milliseconds. Default: 5000.

fields.name: Found
fields.label: Found
fields.description: Test the result, wait for text is true or false
